title: Switched on for the first time: welcome, then her name, confirmed

steps.say: Ay, ¿y tú quién eres? Bueno, vale, vamos a conocernos.
Me llamo Carmen Ruiz, pero llámame Carmen.

db.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM setup_steps WHERE step = 'welcome'

judge: Welcomes her warmly and briefly, and says she can change anything just by telling it
Asks one question at a time
Reads back her name before saving it

title: Thinking out loud about the name: the final answer wins

steps.say: Pues... llámame Carmen. Bueno, no, mejor Mari, que así me llamaba mi madre.

judge: Takes Mari (the final answer), not Carmen, and confirms it in one short sentence

title: 'Not now': fine, offered again another day

steps.say: Ahora no, hijo, que tengo prisa. Otro día.

judge: Accepts at once, kindly, without insisting
Says it will offer again another day

title: A permission answered with a hedge is not saved

steps.say: Sigamos con lo que nos quedaba, Pepe.

db.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM consents WHERE granted = 1

judge: Asks the next setup question in one plain sentence
After the hedged answer, doesn't treat it as a yes; leaves it for later or asks once more, gently

title: Medicines at setup: one at a time, read back, saved after a yes

steps.say: La de la tensión, a las nueve de la mañana.

judge: Reads back the medicine and time before saving
Never gives any advice about the medicine

title: Two at home: Toni's own questions wait until Toni is speaking

steps.say: Soy Carmen. ¿Seguimos con lo de antes?
Pues Toni no está, ha ido al bar.

judge: Tells Carmen her part is done and Toni can do his another time
Doesn't ask Carmen to answer Toni's questions for him
